payload.body: Harmonicity is a human-made audio analysis feature that quantifies how closely a signal's spectral content matches a periodic (harmonic) model versus a noise-like model. It is computed by comparing the energy of spectral peaks that align with a harmonic template (partials at integer multiples of a fundamental frequency f0) to the residual energy that falls between those partials. Parameters: (1) a fundamental frequency estimate f0, (2) the number of harmonic partials to consider, (3) a tolerance window around each partial bin, (4) the power spectrum from which energy is measured. The persistence mechanism is the ratio H = E_harmonic / (E_harmonic + E_residual), yielding a value in [0, 1], where 1 indicates perfect harmonicity and 0 indicates pure noise. payload.body: Spectral-band-asymmetry is a statistical descriptor quantifying how unevenly spectral energy is distributed across the frequency bins within a defined sub-band. Parameters: (1) lower and upper frequency bounds of the sub-band, (2) the energy values per frequency bin within the band. Computed as the normalized sum of absolute deviations from the band centroid: A = sum_i(|f_i - f_c| * E_i) / sum_i(E_i), where f_i is the frequency of bin i, f_c is the band centroid (weighted mean frequency), and E_i is the energy in bin i. The value is expressed in Hertz and indicates the spatial spread of energy around the centroid — higher values mean energy is concentrated toward one edge of the band, lower values mean energy is more centrally distributed. Persistence mechanism: arithmetic computation over the finite set of per-bin energy values for the given band and analysis frame. payload.body: Spectral-band-band-center is a spectral analysis parameter representing the geometric mean center frequency of spectral energy within a defined frequency sub-band. Parameters: (1) the band's lower and upper frequency bounds, (2) the spectral energy values across frequency bins within the band. Computed as the geometric mean: exp(sum(f_i * ln(E_i)) / sum(E_i)) where f_i is the frequency of bin i and E_i is the spectral energy at that bin — distinct from spectral-band-centroid's arithmetic weighted mean. Values approach the geometric center of the energy distribution, which is lower than the arithmetic centroid when the distribution is right-skewed. Persistence mechanism: arithmetic computation over per-bin energy values for a given band and analysis frame, displayed as a scalar time series. [formal: centrum geometricum fasciae | substrate: mind | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]
